svg.title: Reclaim: the escapement
svg.desc: Plate three, Reclaim: a Swiss lever escapement, the escape wheel ticking under the pallet lever as the balance swings, with a three-position selector above it moving between recover, escalate and leave it. A calibrated logistic regression and an expected-value decision in which doing nothing is allowed: 1.42 times the net recovery of retrying every payment, 0.69 ROC-AUC, 574 automated tests with CI. Live, source public.
